description: Explicit top-level `enabled: false` disables all levels branch returns new self(...) with every level force-disabled, BEFORE any nested `class:`/`callable:`/`namespace:` block or top-level `threshold`/`error`/`warning` is even read. description: Flat shorthand at the top level branch: `isset($config['threshold'])` builds `callable` from the top-level threshold/warning/error and hardcodes `class: new Class*ComplexityOptions(enabled: false)`, discarding any `class:`/`callable:` block written beside it. Ledger promises `refuse` for same-named threshold-vs-threshold pairs (2-same-name/4-cross-level with keyB=threshold) but the product silently composes/accepts (MISCOMPOSED "composed where refusal promised"); for cross-level pairs with a different leaf (class.max-error, class.max-warning) the product silently drops the class side entirely (MISCOMPOSED "effect absent").
fix_locality: local: same 3 files, same branch; the fix is "read the nested block regardless of the shorthand" or an explicit documented "replaces" semantics recognised by the ledger/classifier. No channel-identity concept involved.
